description_en: Modifies the video resources of a production studio
name: ModifyCasterVideoResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.
If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, you can obtain the value from the CasterId parameter in the response.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, you can view the ID on the ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page.

The name of the production studio in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the ID of the production studio
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html接口创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource. If you added the video source by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848020.html operation, you can obtain the value from the ResourceId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848020.html接口添加导播台视频源，请查看AddCasterVideoResource接口调用返回的参数ResourceId值
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the video source
parameters.name: resource_name

parameters.help_en:
The streaming URL.

<notice>This parameter is active and required only when the video source type is a live stream.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
直播流地址。

<notice>当视频源类型为直播流时，本参数才可用且必传。
</notice>
parameters.name: live_stream_url

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the video-on-demand (VOD) file.
<notice>This parameter is available only when the video source type is a video file and the video file is not imported into the media asset library.
</notice>
Only VOD files in MP4, FLV, and TS formats are supported
parameters.help_zh:
点播文件地址。
<notice>当视频源类型为文件视频且视频文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。
</notice>
点播文件仅限MP4、FLV、TS格式
parameters.name: vod_url

parameters.help_en:
The start offset of the video file. Unit: milliseconds.

<notice>This parameter takes effect only when the video source type is a video file.
</notice>

A value greater than 0 indicates that the start position for reading is the offset time relative to the first frame
parameters.help_zh:
视频文件起始偏移值。单位：毫秒。

<notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
</notice>

大于0，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间作为开始读取的位置
parameters.name: begin_offset

parameters.help_en:
The end offset. This parameter takes effect only for video files. Unit: milliseconds. 
         
A value greater than 0 indicates that the end position for reading is the offset time relative to the first frame.
A value less than 0 indicates that the end position for reading is the offset time relative to the last frame
parameters.help_zh:
仅对文件视频有效。单位：毫秒。 
         
大于0时，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间为结束读取的位置。
小于0时，表示相对于最后一帧的偏差时间作为结束读取的位置
parameters.name: end_offset

parameters.help_en:
The number of times the video file is replayed after playback is complete. This parameter takes effect only for video files. 
         
0 (default): The video file is not replayed.
-1: The video file is replayed in an infinite loop
parameters.help_zh:
仅对文件视频有效，表示播放完后重复继续播放的次数。 
         
0（默认值）：表示不重复播放。
-1：表示一直循环重复
parameters.name: repeat_num

parameters.help_en: The Presentation Time Stamp (PTS) callback interval. Unit: milliseconds. This parameter takes effect only for VOD materials
parameters.help_zh: PTS回调间隔。单位：毫秒，仅对点播素材有效
parameters.name: pts_callback_interval

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the image material in the media asset library.
This parameter is available and required only when the video source type is an image
parameters.help_zh:
媒资库图片素材ID。
当视频源类型为图片时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image material.
This parameter is available only when the video source type is an image and the image file is not imported into the media asset library. You can upload images in JPG or PNG format. The maximum file size is 10 MB
parameters.help_zh:
图片素材URL。
当视频源类型为图片且图片文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。支持上传jpg、png格式图片，最大文件不可超过10M
parameters.name: image_url

CasterId.description_en: The ID of the production studio. You can use this ID as a request parameter to query the video sources of the production studio, add a layout to the production studio, or query the layouts of the production studio
CasterId.description_zh: 导播台ID。可作为查询导播台视频源、添加导播台布局、查询导播台布局列表的请求参数
